name: 49978-imageprompt-qwen25vl3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, 3.75B params (~7.5 GB bf16): 36-layer decoder (hidden 2048, 16 query / 2 KV heads, head_dim 128) beside a 32-block native-resolution ViT (patch 14, spatial merge 2).
load_profile: constant (open loop), rate 4.0 req/s, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 480 requests with a 900 s safety cap, static seed 49978. A moderate interactive operating point with a shallow queue, not saturation.
workload: single-turn image chat, synthesised by guidellm from three --data sources: 4096 tokens of synthetic text plus two distinct 1092x1092 gradient JPEGs (quality 85, one image source each so both land in one turn), 8 tokens out, temperature 0.0. 7162 input tokens as the engine sees it, read from the checkpoint's own processor.
purpose: A vision chat assistant answering long two-image prompts with brief replies at four requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine is a commit, not a release; `configs/env.yaml` names the built checkout.
# The reader of this file is line-based: a structured value must stay on ONE line, or its key
# is dropped silently and the engine starts without it.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 2}
max-model-len: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
